headline: JustFit Optimizes Large LLM Serving for Laptop Memory
body: Local execution of powerful open models often overwhelms laptop memory limits. JustFit resolves this with an MLX runtime that efficiently manages memory state for large workloads.
caption:
JustFit Optimizes Large LLM Serving for Laptop Memory

Local execution of powerful open models often overwhelms laptop memory limits. JustFit resolves this with an MLX runtime that efficiently manages memory state for large workloads.

Source: arXiv
https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17475v1

title: JustFit: 200K-Token LLM Serving on a 24 GiB Laptop with Just-in-Time State Management
